approval_ref: The active goal requires CRIP to save labor while managing explicit, auditable advanced-model task execution locally.
notes: Require one explicit checked confirmation before sequentially dispatching pending questions.
Use the existing single-item execution endpoint and wait for each saved result; do not add server background dispatch, parallel calls or automatic retry.
Refresh unresolved provider-call state before every next item and stop on any error or unresolved call.
Stop means after the current request; closing or refreshing the page must not auto-resume.
Do not read .local customer data, saved credentials or call a live provider during offline validation.
title: Run pending Reference evaluation questions sequentially
objective: Let one explicit user confirmation sequentially execute the remaining questions in a frozen Reference evaluation, with visible progress, stop-after-current, unresolved-call preflight, no parallelism, no automatic retry and resume from saved result links.
